messages:
ava: FYI planning an SDK 3.2 unpin in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. Found quant/kernel selection mismatch that breaks some qv2-legacy model paths. We need a sticky runtime pin for that model-group until a microkernel patch lands.
sam: ok. Suggest staggered unpin: non-qv2 first, hold qv2-legacy. Deploy slices 10/40/100.
noah: add holdlist entry and explicit routing for qv2-legacy to runtime v2.14.1+kvcache. opsctl snippet: `opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z`
sre-ops: reserving 2 canaries eu-west-1 and 1 eu-central. healthcheck target 200rps. i'll create metrics and eval alerts.
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Rollout: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m. Escape hatch: `deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-unpin-eu-west --reason "telemetry-trigger"`
sam: rollback criteria: 1) 5xx +0.5% vs baseline 2) p95 latency +30% for qv2-legacy once routed 3) token-error-rate/oom spike 4) eval-quality drift >4% on core prompts. If any, abort and re-pin SDK.
ava: i'll draft release notes and internal known-issues. call out expected p95 bump ~10-15% and slightly higher GPU utilization for pinned qv2.
noah: runtime pin command run: `opsctl pin create --target runtime:2.14.1+kvcache --scope model-group:qv2-legacy --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z` -> OK id=pin-9012
sre-ops: warming canaries now, ETA 8m. will post runbook link and alert queries. recommend 20m cooldown between slices.
deploy-bot: started: slice 10%. canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. monitoring links: <metrics dashboard>.
sam: monitoring looks OK so far. keep eyes on p95 and TER.
sre-ops: pod-2 green -> advancing to 40% on schedule. ready to abort if alerts fire.
ava: ops checklist before 23:00: holdlist present, runtime pin active, canaries healthy, alerts configured, release notes drafted, on-call alerted. All owners ack?
sam: ack.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. No rollback triggered.
noah: follow-up: schedule compatibility smoke for other model groups in 48h and track telemetry for 72h. root-cause: quant kernel selection mismatch in optimization pass; patch queued.
